en-CA.description: Simple, ultra-lightweight neofetch clone for Windows 10+
en-CA.longDescription: Simple, ultra-lightweight neofetch clone for Windows 10+ written in C++ and installable through winget(?). The executable is just 62KB and requires no dependencies other than the MS Visual C++ redists (which should be installed already, and if they're not my installer will take care of that for you :)
en-CA.name: neofetch-win
